name: Ionic core (Stencil)
install: bash -c 'set -eo pipefail; export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm install 8.17.0 >/dev/null; export PATH="$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/v8.17.0/bin:$PATH"; echo "using node $(node -v) / npm $(npm -v)"; npm install --no-audit --no-fund --loglevel=error; npm --prefix core install --no-audit --no-fund --loglevel=error; rm -rf core/node_modules/@types/*; echo install-complete'

terminals.name: core-dev-server
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/v8.17.0/bin:$PATH"; cd core && npm run dev
